changes: Native source revision equality replaces content digests for invalidation, TTL revalidation and repair. Empty native versions cannot establish unchanged status.
Query/artifact identities use literal namespace/key tuples serialized as JSON, never content fingerprints.
Gap hydration cache uses addressable source IDs/revisions; adapter must supply one unambiguous source revision per chunk.
Unused provenance fingerprint method removed. Legacy content_hash serialization fields retained empty and ignored for freshness.
Explicit semantic embedder required; no automatic provider choice or hashed lexical fallback.
Only semantic/domain package and upstream license copied. No webhook, CLI or MCP service layer.
preserved: Upstream default semantic-embedder pool resolution, claim scoring/gating, source-bound invalidation, reuse, build, recall, raw fallback, packing and persistence logic otherwise retained. Not a new implementation of the pool algorithm.
scope: Research adaptation under user no-digest constraint, not byte-identical upstream replication or efficacy result. Existing Qwen/BGE/native Store ports still to integrate.

prior_attempts: v1 failed missing json import, fixed in research copy; original failure retained

v2: seven checks passed; failed-flag plus populated claims retained raw but did not necessarily set escalation/needs_retrieval. This upstream behavior remains. Separate v3 empty-claims failure tests actual raw-floor context.
mechanical_check.scope: Deterministic mechanical embeddings/synthesis and temporary SQLite only. Not actual semantic model quality, MiLAi Store integration or benchmark outcome.

known_limitations: The failed-synthesis flag does not itself discard populated claims in upstream. Separate empty-claims failure does fall back to raw context; keep this distinction in provider integration.
Native versions are authoritative adapter metadata. Same source ID/version with changed body violates the adapter contract; this variant deliberately does no content-based validation.
Pool algorithm only mechanically exercised with scripted vectors/synthesis. No actual Qwen/BGE/MiLAi Store or Host run yet.
Webhook/CLI/MCP and hashed lexical embedder excluded; not a complete upstream-package replication.
Initial failed mechanical attempts retained; import fix is included in current patch. Untimed editing overhead unknown.

Literal unit IDs differ from upstream digest IDs, including the deterministic tie-break order when scores are exactly equal. Do not claim bit-identical rankings or results. Full adapter return sizes must include changed provenance metadata.
patch_format: Zero-context unified diff; apply with git apply --unidiff-zero from the original upstream source root.
